title: Demand ledger and the implication order over the recorded open antecedents

concepts.label: open antecedent as a first-class Prop
concepts.note: The type of a named hypothesis binder on a conditional_implication declaration, lifted out of binder position by hypOf% so that it can be named, compared and ordered.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Every open antecedent recorded in docs/semantic/frontier.json is already a Lean Prop, namely the type of a named hypothesis binder on a conditional_implication declaration. The hypOf% elaborator lifts such a binder into a named constant taken from the kernel's ConstantInfo, so the resulting Prop is the hypothesis or elaboration fails. Applying it to the 259 conditional-implication declarations yields 101 distinct closed Props, of which 23 are substantial statements and the remainder are side conditions; the frontier records 52 antecedents in prose.
statement_nodes.engine: hypOf% term elaborator over ConstantInfo, rejecting anonymous and non-closed binders
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Reverse mathematics orders theorems by the axioms they need, by hand and across mathematics. This is the same relation applied inside the recorded gap structure of a single open problem and computed by the kernel. No published formal corpus records enough antecedents of one problem to admit the construction.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Fourteen of the substantial open antecedents of #249 -- the pointwise, ray, multiple, diagonal, cone, jump, window, survivor, rank-two, cone-nonflat, prime-jump and nonintegrality supplies -- are mutually implied, and the class is equivalent to Erdos #249 itself. The reverse direction rests on the corpus completeness theorem irrational_totient_series_iff_pointwise_certificates: the series is irrational exactly when a certified kill exists at every positive shift and every position. These are therefore not antecedents of the problem in any useful sense; they are the problem restated.
statement_nodes.engine: certificate completeness (kill exists iff tail difference non-integral) closing every cofinal supply back to irrationality
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Each individual equivalence is a short argument once the completeness theorem is in hand; the content is that the frontier tracked these fourteen as distinct research targets with distinct closest producers.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For #257 the substantial antecedents form a three-level strict chain so far as the proved edges go: block dyadic safety at the displayed half-orbit state is equivalent to the real dyadic cap, both imply the two-channel cap, and that implies the class of the tempered Moebius-centred carry, the carry upper bound and the unbounded terminal-false seam condition. That bottom class is equivalent to 1/2 in mersenneAchievementSet by half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_iff_unboundedTerminalFalse, so it is the 1/2-membership question itself.
statement_nodes.engine: clearing denominators between block safety and the dyadic cap, then cap domination into the two-channel cap
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The individual steps are short; the content is the ordering, which the frontier did not record.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The three totient block certificate supplies of #249 -- the block certificate, the carry-aware certificate and the low-carry certificate -- form a strict chain, block implies carry-aware implies low-carry, and each implies #249. No edge was found in the reverse direction, so on the proved edges these three are at least as strong as the problem and none is a weaker stepping stone toward it.
statement_nodes.engine: weakening the certificate budget from block to carry-aware to low-carry
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: An absent reverse edge is unproved, not refuted; the separations from the problem class are not established.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: periodLcm t = lcm(1..t) grows by the factor q exactly when t+1 is a prime power q, so the lcm-jump length is (q-1)*periodLcm t; at q = 2, that is t = 2^k - 1, the factor is one and the jump shift equals the diagonal shift. Kills at an lcm-jump shift are therefore exhibited at t = 1, 3, 7 and 31, read off existing diagonal deposits with no new totient arithmetic. The jump route is not an independent obstacle: any cofinal diagonal supply along t = 2^k - 1 discharges it.
statement_nodes.engine: argument coincidence: the corpus indexes certificates by t while certifiedKill depends only on the shift value, and the two indexings collide at t = 2^k - 1
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The arithmetic is elementary. The content is that the corpus recorded only the inequality periodLcm t <= periodLcm (t+1) - periodLcm t and never the equality case, so the jump route was tracked as having no producer at any scale.
